sql: SELECT 'verify-def' AS kind, symbol AS a, file AS b FROM symbol WHERE crate LIKE '%verify%' UNION ALL SELECT 'edge-into-verify' AS kind, from_crate AS a, to_crate AS b FROM crate_edges WHERE to_crate LIKE '%verify%' UNION ALL SELECT 'edge-out-of-verify' AS kind, from_crate AS a, to_crate AS b FROM crate_edges WHERE from_crate LIKE '%verify%'
